slides.title: Tenant locked out and the buzzer is dead?
Check the power first
slides.body: A transformer, often in the basement, feeds the whole system. A weak one makes buzzers hum, click or work only sometimes.

slides.title: Then the door strike
slides.body: If the door shifted or the strike is worn, the buzz sounds upstairs but the door never lets go.

slides.title: Then the wiring
slides.body: Old splices and loose terminals between the panel and each apartment fail first in cold weather.

slides.title: Keep the door aligned
slides.body: Owners who never get the late-night lockout call keep the door closing true, so the strike can release.

slides.label: Test before you replace the panel

slides.title: Save this for later
slides.body: Call us to test all three. Written quote before any big work.
